simpleautofish.message.rod_protected: AutoFish stopped: your fishing rod is about to break
simpleautofish.config.title: Simple AutoFish Settings
simpleautofish.config.enabled.tooltip:
When ON, the rod is reeled in automatically when a fish bites.
Cast once yourself and it keeps going.
simpleautofish.config.auto_recast.toolti:
Cast again automatically after reeling in.
When OFF, the mod only reels in.
simpleautofish.config.protect_rod.toolti: Stop AutoFish when the rod has 3 or less durability left, before it breaks.
simpleautofish.config.fish_in_screens.to:
When ON, keeps reeling in and recasting while a screen (inventory, chat, pause menu...) is open.
When OFF, waits until the screen is closed, like vanilla.
Note: the singleplayer pause menu pauses the game, so fishing stops there anyway.
simpleautofish.mode.fixed.tooltip: Always use the same delay, set with the slider below.
simpleautofish.mode.random_auto.tooltip:
Picks a natural, human-like delay every time.
Nothing to configure. Pick this if unsure.
simpleautofish.mode.random_range.tooltip: Picks a random delay between the minimum and maximum every time.
